title: Messenger Notification
blurb: That distinctive pop means a conversation has begun whether you were consulted or not. Facebook Messenger's alert sits in a very small group of sounds recognised by literal billions of people, alongside WhatsApp's chirp and Apple's tri-tone, and it carries a particular flavour of obligation — Messenger is where relatives, old school friends and marketplace strangers all reach you at once. Editors use it as shorthand for an incoming message without needing to show a screen. Everyone else adds it to the notification-prank arsenal, where it has never once missed.
